thread:
incident-bot: SLO alert: inference p99 latency exceeded threshold for the last 5m on prod (svc=inference-gateway). P95 also creeping up. Paging oncall @jordan :rotating_light:

jordan: Got it, I'm oncall. Looking at dashboards now — any rapid context?

lee: I saw a small spike ~08:12 UTC that correlated with a burst of configfetch errors to config-db. 502s and some timeouts.

marta: Streaming requests showing tail stalls — clients report partial chunking and stalls around token 120-140. Could be KV cache misses + upstream auth delays.

jordan: Pulling logs. `curl -s "https://dash.redwood.internal/api/alerts?svc=inference-gateway"` shows auth latencies spiking to 1.8s at p99. Normal <200ms.

amy: Repro snippet from the gateway logs:
```
2026-06-14T08:13:02Z ERROR auth: token-lookup timeout (500ms) for tenant=acme-corp, route=/v1/generate
2026-06-14T08:13:02Z WARN routing: fallback to model-variant small-quant due to backend timeout
```

ops-bot: Rate limit events: config-db rps -> 6k (5m avg), rate limiter kicked in for configfetch (per-tenant window). See: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/confdb/queries

jordan: Sounds like configfetch and token-store are the choke points. Are we seeing feature-flag fanout?

lee: Yes — new flag rollout for streaming-prefetch pushed an across-the-board sync at 08:10 which caused ~200k flag-checks. That coincided with a burst of client reconns.

marta: Impact: customers on streaming-heavy routes showing higher error/retry rates. We should assess customer-impact list — priority customers: acme-corp, beta-startup, partner-x.

jordan: Immediate mitigations I can try now: 1) Pause flag rollout (rollback), 2) Enable configstore read-cache fallback for 10m, 3) Temporarily relax config-db rate limiter for internal controlplane calls. Any objections?

amy: +1 to cache fallback and flag rollback. For rate limiter change, recommend scoped exception to caller service ids `inference-gateway` and `config-sync` only for the next 15m.

saul: I'll raise a quick DB connection pool increase on the proxy to handle the burst (conn_pool +50). Doing it now.

ops-bot: Command executed: `db-proxy scale-pool --delta 50 --env prod` — queued job id job_9832. ETA ~45s.

lee: I'm toggling the feature flag rollout to off (old cohort). Confirming... flag toggle API returns 200.

jordan: Done — pausing rollout. Also applied temporary rate limiter exception for service ids. Monitor dashboards.

incident-bot: Update: SLO status cleared from critical to degraded at 08:28 UTC. p99 down from 1.8s -> 420ms.

marta: That's improvement but p95 still elevated (280ms). Suggest keeping cache fallback for 30m and schedule a canary of config-db changes. Also we should patch gateway to fall back to cached flags when auth latency > 300ms.

amy: For longer-term: propose a control-plane circuit-breaker for flag fanout, and add batch flag checks in the gateway to reduce chattiness. Will open an RFC/PR after the postmortem.

jordan: Customer comms — @marta can you assemble quick PSR for acme-corp + beta-startup? We should include timeline, impact (incomplete streams, retry patterns), and mitigation steps we've taken.

marta: On it. Drafting note: "Intermittent streaming stalls and elevated latencies due to control-plane config & auth service saturation; temporary mitigations enacted (flag rollback, cache fallback, DB pool increase)." Will send to ops-sig and cs for review.

saul: Follow-up tasks I'm creating: 1) Increase config-db throttle window for the gateway path, 2) Add telemetry for per-tenant flag-check counts, 3) Run a load test to validate connection pool sizing.

ops-bot: Runbook reminder: when control-plane rate-limits cause client retries, prefer cache fallback > relax limiter > scale DB.

jordan: Closing loop: leaving a 1hr watch. If latency regresses, escalate to eng-runtime. Thanks all for fast responses. :heart:

incident-bot: Thread closed for watch. Please add any follow-ups as replies to this thread.
